title: Smart Data Models - ERA EVR - ERTMSErrorChangeRequest
description: ERTMS error change request (era:ERTMSErrorChangeRequest's own definition, verbatim, in the source ontology): SKOS concept representing a change request (CR) classified as an error in the ERTMS specifications and analysed by the Agency to identify whether it may prevent the system from providing normal service under Article 10 of the CCS TSI.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ERTMSErrorChangeRequest'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

changeRequestPreventsService.description: Property. Indicates whether the given ERTMS error change request may prevent the system from providing normal service if not implemented or applied.
